premises.text: Homes with central HVAC waste energy and suffer hot/cold rooms because outdated vents cannot redirect airflow by occupancy
premises.evidence_span: The same household has an average of two to four rooms that are overheated or overcooled at various times

premises.text: User-installed wireless KeenVents automatically redirect HVAC airflow in unoccupied rooms to maximize comfort and efficiency
premises.evidence_span: a wirelessly networked home air vent that maximizes the comfort and efficiency of a home's central heating and cooling system by automatically redirecting the air

premises.text: A Lifestyle Survey programs each vent's smart cycle so users avoid manual programming, with online account services like weather alerts
premises.evidence_span: Customers will complete this short questionnaire with details about their home and habits

premises.text: Smart cycle cuts HVAC runtime by up to 30% and yields material annual energy savings
premises.evidence_span: reduces HVAC run times by up to 30%

premises.text: GTM starts with e-commerce then retail plus partner subsidies from builders, HVAC suppliers, and utilities
premises.evidence_span: leverage e-commerce partnerships to sell the KeenVent directly to consumers via the web

premises.text: Four-vent systems are sold via subscription with monthly service fee or a higher lifetime price, plus matching non-networked vents
premises.evidence_span: A four KeenVents system will be sold for $25 with a $4 monthly service fee

value.text: Homeowners get more comfort and lower heating/cooling bills through intelligent airflow redirection
value.evidence_span: maximizes the comfort and efficiency of a home's central heating and cooling system

causal_links.evidence_span: This is not only uncomfortable, but terribly energy inefficient
eliminates uncomfortable hot or cold spots throughout the home

notes: Energy bill and room imbalance folded as one HVAC problem (§4.1.6). Runtime reduction and dollar savings treated as performance package of the smart-cycle mechanism (§4.1.8) with P4 quantifying that package. Channel cascade (e-com→retail→partners) one GTM premise; subscription vs lifetime one commercial package (§4.1.3). Indiegogo preorder as launch packaging, not financing-ask premise. Anti-template: problem, product, and GTM/pricing separately revisable.
